weekly.overview: This week's energy is asking you to slow down and listen to what your intuition's been trying to tell you. Mercury's vibes suggest clarity is coming, but only if you're willing to sit with the discomfort first. Trust the process.
weekly.love: Whether you're coupled up or flying solo, this is about authenticity over performance. Someone might be trying to get your attention, but the real invitation is to show up as your actual self. No cap, that's the move.
weekly.career: Your creative energy is peaking, even if it doesn't feel like it yet. This is the week to pitch that idea you've been workshopping or take on a project that actually excites you. Small momentum builds into something real.
weekly.health: Your body's asking for grounding this week—whether that's walks, stretching, or just being more present in your day. Energy levels might feel scattered, so lean into what makes you feel centered and whole.
